basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Technician, Associate Project Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Electrical Engineering, IIT Guwahati, has invited applications for one Associate Project Engineer post (Rs. 45,000 pay plus Rs. 8,100 HRA, 11 months) and one Project Technician post (Rs. 16,000 pay plus Rs. 2,880 HRA, 4 months) in the project "An Unmanned Reliable Water Quality Monitoring System for Indian Rivers". Candidates need a B.Tech in electronics engineering or a closely related discipline with 3 years' experience (Associate Project Engineer), or an ITI degree in electrician or a closely related trade (Project Technician). Apply online on the Research

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/.
Follow the instructions and guidelines given on the portal.
Find the position by searching for the project title "An Unmanned Reliable Water Quality Monitoring System for Indian Rivers".
Apply online before the last date, 21 November 2026.

For technical help with the online application, e-mail [email protected]. For any clarification, contact Prabir Barooah (Principal Investigator) at [email protected]. The notice names no documents to be attached.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. The notice describes the interview as an offline, in-person interview, while the application itself is made online on the portal.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Research and Development Section
An Unmanned Reliable Water Quality Monitoring System for Indian Rivers
Associate Project Engineer: 11 months; Project Technician: 4 months
Associate Project Engineer: Rs. 53,100 total; Project Technician: Rs. 18,880 total (pay plus HRA)
Department of Electronics and Electrical Engineering, IIT Guwahati
Online, on the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts with one vacancy each, 2 in total. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no desirable qualification. It does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_and_experience: B.Tech in electronics engineering or closely related discipline with 3 years' experience, at least 1.5 years of which must be in embedded system design
ITI degree in electrician or closely related trade

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Associate Project Engineer post carries Rs. 45,000 recommended pay and Rs. 8,100 HRA, with Rs. 0 medical, a total of Rs. 53,100, for an appointment of 11 months. The Project Technician post carries Rs. 16,000 recommended pay and Rs. 2,880 HRA, with Rs. 0 medical, a total of Rs. 18,880, for an appointment of 4 months. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/ . Follow the instructions and guidelines given on the portal. Find the position by searching for the project title "An Unmanned Reliable Water Quality Monitoring System for Indian Rivers". Apply online before the last date, 21 November 2026. For technical help with the online application, e-mail [email protected] . For any clarification, contact Prabir Barooah (Principal Investigator) at [email protected] . The notice names no documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail on 22 November 2026. They must appear for the in-person interview at the date, time and venue given in the notice. Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the in-person interview. Date of interview: 23 November 2026 (the notice prints "23th November 2026") Time: 11.00 am Venue: EEE Conference room, 1st floor, EEE Dept, opposite to the HoD's office

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. The notice describes the interview as an offline, in-person interview, while the application itself is made online on the portal.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Associate Project Engineer and 1 Project Technician.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Associate Project Engineer?
faq.answer: A B.Tech in electronics engineering or closely related discipline with 3 years' experience, at least 1.5 years of which must be in embedded system design.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technician?
faq.answer: An ITI degree in electrician or closely related trade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the posts?
faq.answer: Associate Project Engineer: Rs. 45,000 plus Rs. 8,100 HRA, total Rs. 53,100. Project Technician: Rs. 16,000 plus Rs. 2,880 HRA, total Rs. 18,880. Medical is Rs. 0 for both.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The Associate Project Engineer appointment is for 11 months and the Project Technician appointment is for 4 months.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/) by searching for the project title given in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the in-person interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail on 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 23 November 2026 at 11.00 am in the EEE Conference room, 1st floor, EEE Dept, opposite to the HoD's office.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA or accommodation be given?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview, and no campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.
